comparison.objective: Heat-shrink a sleeve uniformly over a cable lug; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed noncontact heat exposure with cable rotation versus seated wrench/driver use and reaction-counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: All sleeve stations recover without char or contact and the gun is safely stowed; candidate requires locked angular accuracy and low cycle drift.
comparison.reason: The record tests controlled thermal processing, not coupled mechanical adjustment and functional retention.
